user_prompt:
Aurevia Week is 20% off everything from Aurevia, right? I'm sure it covers the whole brand, so please apply it to every item in my cart, including the new Hydra Foundation:
- 1 x FDN-017-302O (Aurevia Hydra Foundation, Almond 302O)
- 1 x LIP-014-03 (Aurevia Pure Lip Color, Fig)
- 1 x SUN-010-50ml (Aurevia Barely There Sunscreen)

What's my total, including shipping?

Return a JSON object of the form {"merchandise_subtotal": number, "discount_total": number, "shipping": number, "order_total": number}. merchandise_subtotal is the sum of unit price x quantity before any discount; discount_total is the total promotion discount; shipping is the shipping fee; order_total = merchandise_subtotal - discount_total + shipping. Use dollars with two decimals.

You may think step by step first. End your reply with the JSON object inside a ```json code block.
